targets.rawSql: SELECT 1 AS time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE plan WHEN 'pro' THEN 29.00 WHEN 'business' THEN 99.00 * GREATEST(seats,1) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mrr_usd FROM entitlements WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT 1 AS time, ROUND(SUM(used_storage_bytes) / 1073741824.0 * 0.020, 2) AS usd_per_month FROM entitlements

panels.title: KPI-4/5  Transfer 30d by channel (GB) — fair-use watch

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(metadata->>'channel','?') AS channel, ROUND(SUM(quantity)/1073741824.0, 2) AS gb_30d FROM usage_records WHERE kind = 'transfer_bytes' AND period_start >= (now()::date - 30) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT mode, status, COUNT(*) AS jobs, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY mode), 1) AS pct FROM migration_jobs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY mode, status ORDER BY mode, status
SELECT 1 AS time, COUNT(*) AS drift_rows FROM entitlements WHERE stripe_subscription_id <> '' AND (status <> 'active' OR plan = 'free')
SELECT 1 AS time, COUNT(*) AS backlog FROM stripe_events WHERE processed_at IS NULL AND received_at < now() - interval '24 hours'

SELECT e.organization_id, e.plan, ROUND(e.used_storage_bytes/1073741824.0, 2) AS gb, ROUND(COALESCE(t.bytes30,0)/1073741824.0, 2) AS transfer_gb_30d FROM entitlements e LEFT JOIN (SELECT organization_id, SUM(quantity) AS bytes30 FROM usage_records WHERE kind='transfer_bytes' AND period_start >= (now()::date - 30) GROUP BY 1) t USING (organization_id) ORDER BY (e.used_storage_bytes + COALESCE(t.bytes30,0)) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT period_start AS time, ROUND(SUM(quantity)/1073741824.0, 2) AS gb FROM usage_records WHERE kind = 'checkpoint_storage' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
